param.name: mqpar_xml
param.label: MaxQuant Parameter File (mqpar.xml)
param.help: MaxQuant configuration file specifying all analysis parameters

tool.help:
**MaxQuant Label-Free Quantification**
MaxQuant is the gold standard for label-free quantification in proteomics, providing accurate protein quantification with advanced algorithms for peak detection, alignment, and FDR control.
**Key Features:** - Industry-standard LFQ algorithm - Match-between-runs for improved coverage - Advanced peak detection and quantification - Built-in FDR control at peptide and protein level
**Input:** - **mqpar.xml**: MaxQuant parameter file (generated using MaxQuant GUI or programmatically)
**Outputs:** - **proteinGroups.txt**: Protein-level quantification results - **peptides.txt**: Peptide-level results - **evidence.txt**: MS/MS evidence table - **summary.txt**: Run summary statistics
**Citation:** Cox J, Mann M. MaxQuant enables high peptide identification rates, individualized p.p.b.-range mass accuracies and proteome-wide protein quantification. Nat Biotechnol. 2008 Dec;26(12):1367-72. doi: 10.1038/nbt.1511
